services.desc: Looking for things to do in Lancaster, Pennsylvania ? We have a unique country experience for you, floating above scenic Amish Country in a hot air balloon! You’ll be treated to majestic views of The Lancaster Country farmland like you haven’t seen before! Fly over Intercourse, Bird-In-Hand and Strasburg. If you are lucky enough, on a clear day you might catch a glimpse of the headwaters of Chesapeake or Delaware Bay or The NYC and Philly Skylines. Look no further for something fun to do outside in Lancaster, PA, A flight in a peaceful yet exciting hot air balloon ride fits the bill!
